messages:
ana: Hey folks — Penguard procurement emailed: they need SOC 2 Type II (redacted), ISO27001 cert, and a signed pen-test attestation. They asked for these by EOD next Wed. Do we have a standard attestation we can sign?
jamie: We have a template the security/legal combo uses. Link: https://intra.redwood/sales/templates/pen-test-attestation (cc @mike)
mike: I can review + sign from security side, but need the exact scope. Ask buyer: prod only? third‑party vendors? Also we'll need the vendor report to be timeboxed and provide a remediation window.
nana: (typo) ana: they replied back — scope is "production inference endpoints only" and no customer data access.
mike: OK. That's straightforward. Two quick asks: 1) confirm Penguard's pen-test vendor will provide the full report to us (we can accept a redacted copy); 2) we need a 30-day remediation window written into the attestation.
olivia: Legal here — we can sign but request you use the standard limitation language and a 30‑day disclosure/remediation period. Also we require the vendor to sign an NDA before sharing the raw report. Use contact security@redwood-inference.com for the signature block.
jamie: I'll upload the redacted SOC2 and the ISO cert summaries. SOC2 will be redacted for customer names/IPs.
dev-rel-bot: Attachment uploaded: s3://redwood-evidence/pengard-poc/soc2-redacted.pdf (sha256: abc123...)
ops-bot: Ops can produce the list of prod hostnames to include in scope (we'll redact hostnames in the publicly shared attestation). ETA: tomorrow EOD.
nana: (fixed) ana: perfect. Penguard also asked for a one‑page evidence timeline for procurement to attach to the PO. Can someone draft that? They want milestones: evidence handed, signed attestation, pen-test report submission, remediation window.
mike: I'll draft the attestation today. Draft body below — please review:
```
To whom it may concern,
Redwood Inference confirms that a penetration test was conducted by [Vendor] against our production inference endpoints in scope: [redacted]. The vendor report will be provided to Redwood under NDA. Redwood will provide a signed attestation confirming the test took place and that findings will be remediated within 30 days of disclosure. This attestation does not constitute a warranty. Contact: security@redwood-inference.com
```
jamie: Looks good — Legal tweak: add "no implied warranty" clause and add a line about the attestation being limited to the named scope.
olivia: +1 from legal. Also note: include our SOC2 date of issue (2025-11-15) and the ISO cert number; jamie pls redact cert number for distribution.
nana: I'll send Penguard the timeline + the expected delivery dates after ops and jamie attach the docs. Proposed timeline in thread: SOC2 redacted + ISO summary by tomorrow, signed attestation by end of day Tues, vendor report (redacted) shared upon NDA + vendor delivery, remediation window 30 days after disclosure.
ops-bot: Confirmed: host list + redaction-ready inventory scheduled for tomorrow 18:00 UTC.
mike: I'll post final attestation to the S3 path and ping legal for signature. Putting myself owner for attestation (due Tue COB).
jamie: I'll produce the 1‑pager timeline for procurement and attach the SOC2/ISO links.
nana: Thanks team — I'll update Penguard and post the procurement packet. :thumbsup:
